description: Decide whether two .proto sources are compatible, treating the field number as the identity it is. Reports a number freed without a reserved entry, which arms a future field to reinterpret old bytes; a number taken from a reserved range; a wire type change, which stops old messages decoding; a same-wire-type change that alters the decoded value, such as signed to unsigned; a rename, which is wire-safe and breaks generated code; cardinality and oneof moves; and enum number changes. Pay 220000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

after.description: The later source. .proto source, read as a documented subset: messages, enums, fields, oneofs, maps and reserved ranges. Imports are recorded and not followed, and services, extensions and groups are listed as not modelled. Nothing is fetched and no registry is consulted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.

before.description: The earlier source. .proto source, read as a documented subset: messages, enums, fields, oneofs, maps and reserved ranges. Imports are recorded and not followed, and services, extensions and groups are listed as not modelled. Nothing is fetched and no registry is consulted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.

name: protobuf_schema_compatibility

compatible.description: True only when everything was compared and nothing changed in a way that affects a reader, a writer or generated code.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.
